Application Data.NAME: TechConnect Wireless
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TechConnect Wireless is a retail business specializing in the sale and service of cellular phones. Our operations focus on providing high-quality products, including the latest smartphone models, accessories, and repair services. We prioritize customer satisfaction through personalized service and expert support. Additionally, we host occasional low-key promotional events or product launches, compliant with underwriting guidelines to ensure they do not exceed the allowable thresholds.
